name: Brackets
description: A sequence of brackets is called balanced if one can turn it into a valid math expression by adding characters " + " and " 1 ". For example, sequences " (())() ", " () " and " (()(())) " are balanced, while " )( ", " (() " and " (()))( " are not. You are given a string which consists of opening and closing round brackets. Check whether it is a balanced bracket sequence.
input_specification: The only line of input contains a string between 1 and 100 characters long, inclusive. Each character in the string will be " ( " or " ) ".
output_specification: Output " YES " if the bracket sequence is balanced, and " NO " otherwise (quotes for clarity only).
approach_summary: Identify exchange argument or greedy choice property. Sort elements by payoff ratio or deadline and greedily pick candidates to achieve global optimum.
